<script>
// The palette's 12 colors at even steps along its curve, a sheet of paper each, from the angle's tail to its
// head: two to 24 of them, each sheet's lit cut and shadow worked out from its own.
const SHEETS = [
  "#fad95c", "#f8d156", "#f8c451", "#fbb758", "#fea869", "#ff997c",
  "#ff8995", "#fd7cad", "#fe6ec1", "#fe64cf", "#fd5dd2", "#fe59d2"

// seconds it takes to ease in.

const SHAPE = 0;
const SPEED = 1;
const FPS = 60;
const EASE = 1.6;

const DESIGNED = [
  { x: 0.42, y: -0.18, r: 0.38, a: 0.7, ax: 0.1, ay: 0.1, kx: 1, ky: 2, px: 0.4, py: 1.3, b: 0.2, kb: 2, pb: 0.3 },

  { x: -0.12, y: -0.64, r: 0.2, a: 0.42, ax: 0.12, ay: 0.1, kx: 1, ky: 3, px: 4.1, py: 2.4, b: 0.3, kb: 1, pb: 3 },

const DESIGNED_PHASE = [0.7, 2.3, 4.1, 1.2];
const LOOP = 180;
const SPAN = 0.75;
const FRAME_HW = 0.5 / SPAN;
const FRAME_HH = 0.28125 / SPAN;
const MAX_BUMPS = 6;
const MAX_SHEETS = 24;
const BUMP = 4;
const QUARTER = 4;
const REACH = 2.54;
const GRID_W = 128;
const GRID_H = 72;
const SPECK = 0.004;
const YELLOW = 100;
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const round = (v, step) => Math.round(v / step) * step;

// mulberry32: the design's random numbers, the same everywhere.
function rng(seed) {

// A shape's relief: 0 the designed one (a peak toward the head, a basin toward the tail, a small island and a dip),

// sign so the sheets keep their shares, and the waves' phases.

      ky: 1 + Math.floor(r() * 3),
      px: r() * 6.2832,
      py: r() * 6.2832,

      kb: 1 + Math.floor(r() * 3),
      pb: r() * 6.2832

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

// Each sheet's colors from its own: its face, its lit cut a little lighter, and the shadow it casts on the sheet below,

function sheetColors(hex) {

  const wallHex = lch.map(([L, C, H]) => toHex(lchToSrgb(Math.min(1, L + LOOK.wallLift), C * 0.9, H)));

// The papercut in a canvas of W by H pixels at ANGLE and SHAPE: the ramp along the angle, the relief, the light from the
// angle's head turned toward the top, the sheets, their colors, and each one's shadows in pixels.
const levelsKept = new Map();
function papercutScene(angle, shape, width, height) {
  const D = SPAN * Math.max(width, height);
  const rad = (angle * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dx = Math.sin(rad);
  const dy = -Math.cos(rad);
  const half = Math.max(LOOK.rampMin, Math.abs(dx) * FRAME_HW + Math.abs(dy) * FRAME_HH);
  const le = (LOOK.lean * Math.PI) / 180;
  let px = dy;
  let py = -dx;
  if (py > 0 || (py === 0 && px < 0)) {
    px = -px;
    py = -py;
  }
  const lx = Math.cos(le) * dx + Math.sin(le) * px;
  const ly = Math.cos(le) * dy + Math.sin(le) * py;
  const layout = relief(shape);
  const n = Math.max(2, Math.min(MAX_SHEETS, SHEETS.length));
  const hex = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => SHEETS[Math.min(i, SHEETS.length - 1)]);
  const thick = k => (LOOK.index > 0 && k % LOOK.index === 0 ? LOOK.indexScale : 1);
  const m = {
    width,
    height,
    D,
    rx: (dx / half) * LOOK.slope,
    ry: (dy / half) * LOOK.slope,
    bumps: layout.bumps,
    wa: LOOK.warp,
    wf: LOOK.warpFreq,
    wa2: LOOK.warp2,
    wf2: LOOK.warpFreq2,
    phase: layout.phase,
    cycles: [1, -1, 2, -1],
    lx,
    ly,
    swing: (LOOK.swing * Math.PI) / 180,
    n,
    levels: [],

    offset: Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => round(LOOK.shadowOffset * D * thick(k), 0.01)),

// The frame at t (seconds of the loop at speed 1): every hill's middle, 1/r^2 and height, then the waves' phases, then
// toward the light, into `at`.
function frameAt(m, time, at) {

    at[o + 1] = (b.y + b.ay * (Math.sin(w * b.ky * t + b.py) - Math.sin(b.py))) * FRAME_HH;
    at[o + 2] = 1 / (b.r * b.r);
    at[o + 3] = b.a * (1 + b.b * (Math.sin(w * b.kb * t + b.pb) - Math.sin(b.pb)));

// each then moved a hair past any island or hole it would cut smaller than SPECK of the box, so the first frame never
// shows a speck.

  const gh = GRID_H;

  const vals = new Float64Array(cells);
  for (let j = 0; j < gh; j++)
    for (let i = 0; i < gw; i++)
      vals[j * gw + i] = fieldValue(m, at, ((i + 0.5) / gw - 0.5) * 2 * FRAME_HW, ((j + 0.5) / gh - 0.5) * 2 * FRAME_HH);
  const sorted = vals.slice().sort();
  const shares = Array.from({ length: m.n - 1 }, (_, k) => sorted[Math.floor(((k + 1) / m.n) * cells)]);
  const levels = shares.slice();
  const label = new Int32Array(cells);
  const stack = new Int32Array(cells);
  const min = SPECK * cells;

    for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) {

      label.fill(0);

      let id = 0;
      for (let s = 0; s < cells && !moved; s++) {
        if (label[s]) continue;

        const above = vals[s] >= L;
        id++;
        let top = 0;
        stack[top++] = s;
        label[s] = id;
        let size = 0;
        let edge = false;
        let lo = Infinity;
        let hi = -Infinity;
        while (top) {
          const c = stack[--top];
          size++;
          const v = vals[c];
          if (v < lo) lo = v;
          if (v > hi) hi = v;
          const i = c % gw;
          const j = (c - i) / gw;
          if (i === 0 || j === 0 || i === gw - 1 || j === gh - 1) edge = true;
          if (i > 0 && !label[c - 1] && vals[c - 1] >= L === above) {
            label[c - 1] = id;
            stack[top++] = c - 1;
          }
          if (i < gw - 1 && !label[c + 1] && vals[c + 1] >= L === above) {
            label[c + 1] = id;
            stack[top++] = c + 1;
          }
          if (j > 0 && !label[c - gw] && vals[c - gw] >= L === above) {
            label[c - gw] = id;
            stack[top++] = c - gw;
          }
          if (j < gh - 1 && !label[c + gw] && vals[c + gw] >= L === above) {

  for (let k = 1; k < out.length; k++)
    if (out[k] <= out[k - 1] && (out[k] !== share[k] || out[k - 1] !== share[k - 1])) {

// the contact's opacity with the lit cut's width.

  level.set(m.levels);
  const face = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 3);
  face.set(m.face);
  const wall = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 3);

  const shadow = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 3);
  shadow.set(m.shadowRgb);

  antialias: false,

      if (changed || (at !== lastDrawn && due(now))) {

        lastDrawn = at;
        changed = false;
        first = false;
      }

  };

  };

  const sizes = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    const box = entries[entries.length - 1]?.devicePixelContentBoxSize?.[0];

    settle = setTimeout(
      () => {

  }

  });

    changed = true;
    wake();
  });
  // A GPU lost draws nothing, and the loop stops until a new drawing is made on the one found again, which is laid out
  // and drawn at once, the clock going on from where it was.
  const lose = () => {
    lost = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
  };
  const found = () => {
    lost = false;
    laidOut = false;
    resize();
    changed = true;
    wake();
  };

  canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextlost", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    lose();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextrestored", () => {
    make();
    found();
  });

    width,
    height,
    D,
    rx: (dx / half) * LOOK.slope,
    ry: (dy / half) * LOOK.slope,
    bumps: layout.bumps,
    wa: LOOK.warp,
    wf: LOOK.warpFreq,
    wa2: LOOK.warp2,
    wf2: LOOK.warpFreq2,
    phase: layout.phase,
    cycles: [1, -1, 2, -1],

    ly,
    swing: (LOOK.swing * Math.PI) / 180,

    offset: Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => round(LOOK.shadowOffset * D * thick(k), 0.01)),
    alpha: Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => round(Math.min(0.9, LOOK.shadowAlpha * Math.sqrt(thick(k))), 0.001)),

}

// The frame at t (seconds of the loop at speed 1): every hill's middle, 1/r^2 and height, then the waves' phases, then
// toward the light, into `at`.
function frameAt(m, time, at) {
  const t = time - LOOP * Math.floor(time / LOOP);
  const w = TAU / LOOP;
  for (let i = 0; i < m.bumps.length; i++) {
    const b = m.bumps[i];
    const o = i * BUMP;
    at[o] = (b.x + b.ax * (Math.cos(w * b.kx * t + b.px) - Math.cos(b.px))) * FRAME_HW;

    at[o + 2] = 1 / (b.r * b.r);

  for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) at[o + j] = m.phase[j] + w * m.cycles[j] * t;

  const a = m.swing * Math.sin(w * t);
  const c = Math.cos(a);
  const s = Math.sin(a);
  at[o + 4] = c * m.lx - s * m.ly;
  at[o + 5] = s * m.lx + c * m.ly;

// The field alone at q (D units), as the field pass works it out with its slope and curvature.
function fieldValue(m, at, qx, qy) {
  const nb = m.bumps.length;
  const o = nb * BUMP;
  const wx = qx + m.wa * Math.sin(m.wf * qy + at[o]) + m.wa2 * Math.sin(m.wf2 * (qx - qy) + at[o + 3]);
  const wy = qy + m.wa * Math.sin(m.wf * qx + at[o + 1]) + m.wa2 * Math.sin(m.wf2 * (qx + qy) + at[o + 2]);
  let f = wx * m.rx + wy * m.ry;
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
    const b = i * BUMP;
    const ex = wx - at[b];
    const ey = wy - at[b + 1];
    const s = (ex * ex + ey * ey) * at[b + 2];
    if (s < 1) {
      const k = 1 - s;
      f += at[b + 3] * k * k * k;
    }
  }
  return f;
}

// The levels that give every sheet an equal share of the design's box at t = 0 (quantiles of the field over a grid),
// each then moved a hair past any island or hole it would cut smaller than SPECK of the box, so the first frame never
// shows a speck.
function levelsOf(m) {
  const gw = GRID_W;
  const gh = GRID_H;
  const cells = gw * gh;
  const at = new Float64Array(m.bumps.length * BUMP + 6);
  frameAt(m, 0, at);
  const vals = new Float64Array(cells);
  for (let j = 0; j < gh; j++)
    for (let i = 0; i < gw; i++)
      vals[j * gw + i] = fieldValue(m, at, ((i + 0.5) / gw - 0.5) * 2 * FRAME_HW, ((j + 0.5) / gh - 0.5) * 2 * FRAME_HH);
  const sorted = vals.slice().sort();
  const shares = Array.from({ length: m.n - 1 }, (_, k) => sorted[Math.floor(((k + 1) / m.n) * cells)]);
  const levels = shares.slice();
  const label = new Int32Array(cells);
  const stack = new Int32Array(cells);
  const min = SPECK * cells;
  for (let k = 0; k < levels.length; k++) {
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) {
      const L = levels[k];
      label.fill(0);
      let moved = false;
      let id = 0;
      for (let s = 0; s < cells && !moved; s++) {
        if (label[s]) continue;
        // flood one region on one side of the level
        const above = vals[s] >= L;
        id++;
        let top = 0;
        stack[top++] = s;
        label[s] = id;
        let size = 0;
        let edge = false;
        let lo = Infinity;
        let hi = -Infinity;
        while (top) {
          const c = stack[--top];
          size++;
          const v = vals[c];
          if (v < lo) lo = v;
          if (v > hi) hi = v;
          const i = c % gw;
          const j = (c - i) / gw;
          if (i === 0 || j === 0 || i === gw - 1 || j === gh - 1) edge = true;
          if (i > 0 && !label[c - 1] && vals[c - 1] >= L === above) {
            label[c - 1] = id;
            stack[top++] = c - 1;
          }
          if (i < gw - 1 && !label[c + 1] && vals[c + 1] >= L === above) {
            label[c + 1] = id;
            stack[top++] = c + 1;
          }
          if (j > 0 && !label[c - gw] && vals[c - gw] >= L === above) {
            label[c - gw] = id;
            stack[top++] = c - gw;
          }
          if (j < gh - 1 && !label[c + gw] && vals[c + gw] >= L === above) {
            label[c + gw] = id;
            stack[top++] = c + gw;
          }
        }

    }

    if (out[k] <= out[k - 1] && (out[k] !== share[k] || out[k - 1] !== share[k - 1])) {
      out[k] = share[k];
      out[k - 1] = share[k - 1];

// The field's texture for a canvas: a sample every QUARTER pixels each way and one past each edge.

// sheets' colors, each sheet's 1 / sigma, offset, opacity and the contact's 1 / sigma, the second sheet up's reach, and
// the contact's opacity with the lit cut's width.
function sceneUniforms(m) {

  level.set(m.levels);

  face.set(m.face);
  const wall = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 3);
  wall.set(m.wallRgb);
  const shadow = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 3);
  shadow.set(m.shadowRgb);
  const reach = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS);
  reach.set(m.reach);
  const sheet = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 4);

    sheet[k * 4 + 3] = m.icsigma;

// A frame's uniforms at t, as the player sets them: the hills' (MAX_BUMPS vec4s) into `bump`, the waves' four phases
// and toward the light into `rest`, by way of `at`, a scratch of floats as the player's.

// The drawing, WebGL 2, as the site's player draws it: the same two passes, texture and uniforms, so each frame's GPU
// work is the player's.

const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl2", {
  alpha: false,
  antialias: false,
  depth: false,
  stencil: false,
  premultipliedAlpha: true,

  // sample every fourth pixel each way and one past each edge, each float kept whole as its bits.

  const at = new Float32Array(MAX_BUMPS * BUMP + 6);
  const bump = new Float32Array(MAX_BUMPS * BUMP);

      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;

      th = size.h;

  };

  // sheets shaded from it on the canvas. What holds for the canvas is
  // set once it is laid out.
  const draw = t => {
    gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
    if (!sent) {
      const u = sceneUniforms(scene);
      gl.useProgram(pShade);
      gl.uniform2f(US.uSize, scene.width, scene.height);
      gl.uniform1f(US.uD, scene.D);
      gl.uniform1i(US.uSheets, scene.n);
      gl.uniform1fv(US.uLevel, u.level);
      gl.uniform3fv(US.uFace, u.face);
      gl.uniform3fv(US.uWallC, u.wall);
      gl.uniform3fv(US.uShade, u.shadow);

      gl.uniform1f(UF.uD, scene.D);
      gl.uniform2f(UF.uRamp, scene.rx, scene.ry);

    }

    gl.useProgram(pField);
    gl.uniform4fv(UF.uBump, bump);
    gl.uniform4f(UF.uPhase, rest[0], rest[1], rest[2], rest[3]);

    gl.viewport(0, 0, tw, th);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
    // the sheets, shaded from it

    gl.useProgram(pShade);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, field);
    gl.uniform2f(US.uLight, rest[4], rest[5]);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, scene.width, scene.height);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
  };

  // The canvas's size in device pixels as the browser lays it out, up to a 4K screen's pixels, as the player sizes it.
  const PIXELS_MAX = 8300000;
  let pixels = null;
  let laidOut = false;
  const resize = () => {
    const dpr = devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const css = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!css.width || !css.height) return;
    const ew = Math.round(css.width * dpr);
    const eh = Math.round(css.height * dpr);
    const exact = pixels && Math.abs(pixels.w - ew) <= 2 && Math.abs(pixels.h - eh) <= 2;
    const w0 = exact ? pixels.w : ew;
    const h0 = exact ? pixels.h : eh;
    const fit = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(PIXELS_MAX / Math.max(1, w0 * h0)));
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w0 * fit));
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h0 * fit));
    layout(w, h);
    laidOut = true;
  };

  // The clock: seconds of the loop at speed 1, advanced by SPEED, so the motion eases in from rest over EASE seconds once
  // the first frame is drawn. A frame is drawn when the picture changed or one is due at FPS; a reader who asks for
  // less motion sees the first frame.
  const reduced = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  let lost = false;
  const playing = () => !document.hidden && !reduced.matches && !lost;
  let t = 0;
  let warm = 0;
  let last = performance.now();
  let lastDrawn = -1;
  let changed = true;
  let first = true;
  let raf = 0;
  let settle = 0;
  // A frame is due once each 1/FPS, a little early rather than a refresh late, counted from the last one's due time.
  let paced = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  const due = now => {
    if (!FPS) return true;
    const every = 1000 / FPS;
    if (now - paced < every - Math.min(4, every * 0.2)) return false;
    paced = now - paced > 2 * every ? now : paced + every;
    return true;
  };
  const tick = now => {
    raf = 0;
    if (lost) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    if (!playing() || SPEED === 0) warm = 0;
    else if (laidOut && !first) {
      warm = Math.min(EASE, warm + dt);
      const e = EASE ? warm / EASE : 1;
      t += dt * SPEED * e * e * (3 - 2 * e);
    }
    if (laidOut) {
      const at = reduced.matches ? 0 : t;
      if (changed || (at !== lastDrawn && due(now))) {
        draw(at);
        lastDrawn = at;
        changed = false;
        first = false;
      }
    }
    if (playing() && SPEED > 0) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  const wake = () => {
    last = performance.now();
    if (!raf && !lost) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  // The first size comes before the first paint; a later one settles a moment before the drawing is laid out again.
  const sizes = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    const box = entries[entries.length - 1]?.devicePixelContentBoxSize?.[0];
    pixels = box ? { w: box.inlineSize, h: box.blockSize } : null;
    clearTimeout(settle);
    settle = setTimeout(
      () => {
        resize();
        changed = true;
        wake();
      },
      laidOut ? 150 : 0
    );
  });
  try {
    sizes.observe(canvas, { box: "device-pixel-content-box" });
  } catch {
    sizes.observe(canvas);
  }
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (!document.hidden) wake();
  });
  reduced.addEventListener("change", () => {
    changed = true;
    wake();
  });
  // A GPU lost draws nothing, and the loop stops until a new drawing is made on the one found again, which is laid out
  // and drawn at once, the clock going on from where it was.
  const lose = () => {
    lost = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
  };
  const found = () => {
    lost = false;
    laidOut = false;
    resize();
    changed = true;
    wake();
  };
  // A lost context draws nothing until the browser gives it back: everything the GPU held is then made again on it.
  canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextlost", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    lose();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextrestored", () => {
    make();
    found();
  });
}
</script>

  const s = (L - 0.0894841775 * a - 1.291485548 * b) ** 3;
  return [
    4.0767416621 * l - 3.3077115913 * m + 0.2309699292 * s,
    -1.2684380046 * l + 2.6097574011 * m - 0.3413193965 * s,
    -0.0041960863 * l - 0.7034186147 * m + 1.707614701 * s
  ];
}
function linOklab(r, g, b) {
  const l = Math.cbrt(0.4122214708 * r + 0.5363325363 * g + 0.0514459929 * b);
  const m = Math.cbrt(0.2119034982 * r + 0.6806995451 * g + 0.1073969566 * b);
  const s = Math.cbrt(0.0883024619 * r + 0.2817188376 * g + 0.6299787005 * b);
  return [
    0.2104542553 * l + 0.793617785 * m - 0.0040720468 * s,
    1.9779984951 * l - 2.428592205 * m + 0.4505937099 * s,
    0.0259040371 * l + 0.7827717662 * m - 0.808675766 * s
  ];
}
const inGamut = rgb => rgb.every(v => v >= -1e-4 && v <= 1 + 1e-4);
function fitChroma(L, C, H) {
  L = clamp01(L);
  C = Math.max(0, C);
  const ca = Math.cos(H * DEG);
  const sa = Math.sin(H * DEG);
  if (inGamut(oklabToLinear(L, C * ca, C * sa))) return C;
  let lo = 0;
  let hi = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
    const m = (lo + hi) / 2;
    if (inGamut(oklabToLinear(L, C * m * ca, C * m * sa))) lo = m;
    else hi = m;
  }
  return C * lo;
}
function lchToSrgb(L, C, H) {
  L = clamp01(L);
  const c = fitChroma(L, C, H);
  return oklabToLinear(L, c * Math.cos(H * DEG), c * Math.sin(H * DEG)).map(v => clamp01(toEncoded(clamp01(v))));
}
function srgbToLch(rgb) {
  const [L, a, b] = linOklab(toLinear(rgb[0]), toLinear(rgb[1]), toLinear(rgb[2]));
  return [L, Math.hypot(a, b), Math.atan2(b, a) / DEG];
}
const toHex = rgb => `#${rgb.map(v => Math.round(clamp01(v) * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")}`;
const bytes = hex => [1, 3, 5].map(i => Number.parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255);

// Each sheet's colors from its own: its face, its lit cut a little lighter, and the shadow it casts on the sheet below,
// that paper deeper, a yellow's turned toward ochre (kept at its own hue it goes olive, which no paper's shadow does).
function sheetColors(hex) {
  const lch = hex.map(h => srgbToLch(bytes(h)));
  const wallHex = lch.map(([L, C, H]) => toHex(lchToSrgb(Math.min(1, L + LOOK.wallLift), C * 0.9, H)));
  const shadowHex = lch.map((_, k) => {
    const [L, C, H] = lch[Math.max(0, k - 1)];
    const off = ((((H - YELLOW) % 360) + 540) % 360) - 180;
    const turn = LOOK.ochre * Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(off) / 45) * Math.min(1, C / 0.06);
    return toHex(lchToSrgb(L * LOOK.shadowDepth, C * LOOK.shadowChroma, H - turn));
  });
  return { face: hex.flatMap(bytes), wallRgb: wallHex.flatMap(bytes), shadowRgb: shadowHex.flatMap(bytes) };
}

// The papercut in a canvas of W by H pixels at ANGLE and SHAPE: the ramp along the angle, the relief, the light from the
// angle's head turned toward the top, the sheets, their colors, and each one's shadows in pixels.
const levelsKept = new Map();
function papercutScene(angle, shape, width, height) {
  const D = SPAN * Math.max(width, height);
  const rad = (angle * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dx = Math.sin(rad);
  const dy = -Math.cos(rad);
  const half = Math.max(LOOK.rampMin, Math.abs(dx) * FRAME_HW + Math.abs(dy) * FRAME_HH);
  const le = (LOOK.lean * Math.PI) / 180;
  let px = dy;
  let py = -dx;
  if (py > 0 || (py === 0 && px < 0)) {
    px = -px;
    py = -py;
  }
  const lx = Math.cos(le) * dx + Math.sin(le) * px;
  const ly = Math.cos(le) * dy + Math.sin(le) * py;
  const layout = relief(shape);
  const n = Math.max(2, Math.min(MAX_SHEETS, SHEETS.length));
  const hex = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => SHEETS[Math.min(i, SHEETS.length - 1)]);
  const thick = k => (LOOK.index > 0 && k % LOOK.index === 0 ? LOOK.indexScale : 1);
  const m = {
    width,
    height,
    D,
    rx: (dx / half) * LOOK.slope,
    ry: (dy / half) * LOOK.slope,
    bumps: layout.bumps,
    wa: LOOK.warp,
    wf: LOOK.warpFreq,
    wa2: LOOK.warp2,
    wf2: LOOK.warpFreq2,
    phase: layout.phase,
    cycles: [1, -1, 2, -1],
    lx,
    ly,
    swing: (LOOK.swing * Math.PI) / 180,
    n,
    levels: [],
    ...sheetColors(hex),
    // a hundredth of a pixel at least, so a canvas a few pixels wide divides by none
    sigma: Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => Math.max(0.01, round(LOOK.shadowBlur * D * Math.sqrt(thick(k)), 0.01))),
    offset: Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => round(LOOK.shadowOffset * D * thick(k), 0.01)),
    alpha: Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => round(Math.min(0.9, LOOK.shadowAlpha * Math.sqrt(thick(k))), 0.001)),
    csigma: Math.max(0.01, round(LOOK.contactBlur * D, 0.01)),
    calpha: round(LOOK.contactAlpha, 0.001),
    wall: round(LOOK.wall * D, 0.01)
  };
  m.isigma = m.sigma.map(v => 1 / v);
  m.reach = m.sigma.map((v, k) => round(1.5 * (m.offset[k] + REACH * v), 0.01));
  m.icsigma = 1 / m.csigma;
  // the levels depend on the angle, the shape and the sheets alone, never on the canvas: found once
  const view = `${angle}|${shape || 0}|${hex.length}`;
  if (!levelsKept.has(view)) levelsKept.set(view, levelsOf(m));
  m.levels = levelsKept.get(view).slice();
  return m;
}

// The frame at t (seconds of the loop at speed 1): every hill's middle, 1/r^2 and height, then the waves' phases, then
// toward the light, into `at`.
function frameAt(m, time, at) {
  const t = time - LOOP * Math.floor(time / LOOP);
  const w = TAU / LOOP;
  for (let i = 0; i < m.bumps.length; i++) {
    const b = m.bumps[i];
    const o = i * BUMP;
    at[o] = (b.x + b.ax * (Math.cos(w * b.kx * t + b.px) - Math.cos(b.px))) * FRAME_HW;
    at[o + 1] = (b.y + b.ay * (Math.sin(w * b.ky * t + b.py) - Math.sin(b.py))) * FRAME_HH;
    at[o + 2] = 1 / (b.r * b.r);
    at[o + 3] = b.a * (1 + b.b * (Math.sin(w * b.kb * t + b.pb) - Math.sin(b.pb)));
  }
  const o = m.bumps.length * BUMP;
  for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) at[o + j] = m.phase[j] + w * m.cycles[j] * t;
  // the light's swing: a sine, so it leaves the designed light at t = 0 at its fastest and turns back at the ends
  const a = m.swing * Math.sin(w * t);
  const c = Math.cos(a);
  const s = Math.sin(a);
  at[o + 4] = c * m.lx - s * m.ly;
  at[o + 5] = s * m.lx + c * m.ly;
}

// The field alone at q (D units), as the field pass works it out with its slope and curvature.
function fieldValue(m, at, qx, qy) {
  const nb = m.bumps.length;
  const o = nb * BUMP;
  const wx = qx + m.wa * Math.sin(m.wf * qy + at[o]) + m.wa2 * Math.sin(m.wf2 * (qx - qy) + at[o + 3]);
  const wy = qy + m.wa * Math.sin(m.wf * qx + at[o + 1]) + m.wa2 * Math.sin(m.wf2 * (qx + qy) + at[o + 2]);
  let f = wx * m.rx + wy * m.ry;
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
    const b = i * BUMP;
    const ex = wx - at[b];
    const ey = wy - at[b + 1];
    const s = (ex * ex + ey * ey) * at[b + 2];
    if (s < 1) {
      const k = 1 - s;
      f += at[b + 3] * k * k * k;
    }
  }
  return f;
}

// The levels that give every sheet an equal share of the design's box at t = 0 (quantiles of the field over a grid),
// each then moved a hair past any island or hole it would cut smaller than SPECK of the box, so the first frame never
// shows a speck.
function levelsOf(m) {
  const gw = GRID_W;
  const gh = GRID_H;
  const cells = gw * gh;
  const at = new Float64Array(m.bumps.length * BUMP + 6);
  frameAt(m, 0, at);
  const vals = new Float64Array(cells);
  for (let j = 0; j < gh; j++)
    for (let i = 0; i < gw; i++)
      vals[j * gw + i] = fieldValue(m, at, ((i + 0.5) / gw - 0.5) * 2 * FRAME_HW, ((j + 0.5) / gh - 0.5) * 2 * FRAME_HH);
  const sorted = vals.slice().sort();
  const shares = Array.from({ length: m.n - 1 }, (_, k) => sorted[Math.floor(((k + 1) / m.n) * cells)]);
  const levels = shares.slice();
  const label = new Int32Array(cells);
  const stack = new Int32Array(cells);
  const min = SPECK * cells;
  for (let k = 0; k < levels.length; k++) {
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) {
      const L = levels[k];
      label.fill(0);
      let moved = false;
      let id = 0;
      for (let s = 0; s < cells && !moved; s++) {
        if (label[s]) continue;
        // flood one region on one side of the level
        const above = vals[s] >= L;
        id++;
        let top = 0;
        stack[top++] = s;
        label[s] = id;
        let size = 0;
        let edge = false;
        let lo = Infinity;
        let hi = -Infinity;
        while (top) {
          const c = stack[--top];
          size++;
          const v = vals[c];
          if (v < lo) lo = v;
          if (v > hi) hi = v;
          const i = c % gw;
          const j = (c - i) / gw;
          if (i === 0 || j === 0 || i === gw - 1 || j === gh - 1) edge = true;
          if (i > 0 && !label[c - 1] && vals[c - 1] >= L === above) {
            label[c - 1] = id;
            stack[top++] = c - 1;
          }
          if (i < gw - 1 && !label[c + 1] && vals[c + 1] >= L === above) {
            label[c + 1] = id;
            stack[top++] = c + 1;
          }
          if (j > 0 && !label[c - gw] && vals[c - gw] >= L === above) {
            label[c - gw] = id;
            stack[top++] = c - gw;
          }
          if (j < gh - 1 && !label[c + gw] && vals[c + gw] >= L === above) {
            label[c + gw] = id;
            stack[top++] = c + gw;
          }
        }
        if (edge || size >= min) continue;
        // a speck: the level moved a hair past it, so it is gone
        levels[k] = above ? hi + 1e-4 : lo - 1e-4;
        moved = true;
      }
      if (!moved) break;
    }
  }
  // a speck nested in another would move two levels past one top, to the same place: both keep their shares instead
  const out = levels.map(v => round(v, 1e-6));
  const share = shares.map(v => round(v, 1e-6));
  for (let k = 1; k < out.length; k++)
    if (out[k] <= out[k - 1] && (out[k] !== share[k] || out[k - 1] !== share[k - 1])) {
      out[k] = share[k];
      out[k - 1] = share[k - 1];
      k = Math.max(0, k - 2);
    }
  return out;
}

// The field's texture for a canvas: a sample every QUARTER pixels each way and one past each edge.
const fieldSize = m => ({ w: Math.ceil((m.width - 1) / QUARTER) + 3, h: Math.ceil((m.height - 1) / QUARTER) + 3 });

// The shading pass's uniforms, as the player sets them once a palette, a view or a canvas changes: the levels, the
// sheets' colors, each sheet's 1 / sigma, offset, opacity and the contact's 1 / sigma, the second sheet up's reach, and
// the contact's opacity with the lit cut's width.
function sceneUniforms(m) {
  const level = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS);
  level.set(m.levels);
  const face = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 3);
  face.set(m.face);
  const wall = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 3);
  wall.set(m.wallRgb);
  const shadow = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 3);
  shadow.set(m.shadowRgb);
  const reach = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS);
  reach.set(m.reach);
  const sheet = new Float32Array(MAX_SHEETS * 4);
  for (let k = 0; k < m.n; k++) {
    sheet[k * 4] = m.isigma[k];
    sheet[k * 4 + 1] = m.offset[k];
    sheet[k * 4 + 2] = m.alpha[k];
    sheet[k * 4 + 3] = m.icsigma;
  }
  return { level, face, wall, shadow, sheet, reach, misc: [m.calpha, m.wall] };
}

// A frame's uniforms at t, as the player sets them: the hills' (MAX_BUMPS vec4s) into `bump`, the waves' four phases
// and toward the light into `rest`, by way of `at`, a scratch of floats as the player's.
function frameUniforms(m, t, at, bump, rest) {
  frameAt(m, t, at);
  const nb = m.bumps.length * BUMP;
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) bump[i] = at[i];
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) rest[i] = at[nb + i];
}

// The drawing, WebGPU, as the site's player draws it with WebGL: the same two passes and numbers.
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const request = async () => {
  const adapter = await navigator.gpu?.requestAdapter().catch(() => null);
  return (await adapter?.requestDevice().catch(() => null)) ?? null;
};
let gpu = await request();
if (gpu) play();
else document.body.textContent = "This page needs WebGPU, which this browser does not have.";

function play() {
  const context = canvas.getContext("webgpu");
  const format = navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat();
  const pipeline = (id, target) => {
    const shader = gpu.createShaderModule({ code: document.getElementById(id).textContent });
    return gpu.createRenderPipeline({
      layout: "auto",
      vertex: { module: shader, entryPoint: "vs_main" },
      fragment: { module: shader, entryPoint: "fs_main", targets: [{ format: target }] },
      primitive: { topology: "triangle-list" }
    });
  };

  // What the GPU holds, made at the start and again on a new device where the old one is lost: the two passes and
  // their uniforms.
  let pField, pShade, fieldBuffer, shadeBuffer, field, groups;
  const make = () => {
    context.configure({ device: gpu, format, alphaMode: "opaque" });
    pField = pipeline("papercut-field", "rgba32uint");
    pShade = pipeline("papercut-shade", format);
    fieldBuffer = gpu.createBuffer({ size: 160, usage: GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST });
    shadeBuffer = gpu.createBuffer({ size: 1760, usage: GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST });
    field = null;
    groups = null;
  };
  make();

  // The canvas at its size, w by h device pixels: the papercut laid out for it, the field's texture its size, and the
  // uniforms that hold for it. The field pass's: the canvas and D (12 bytes), the hills' count, the ramp, the waves,
  // their phases, the hills. The shading pass's: the canvas, D, the sheets' count, the light, the contact's opacity and
  // the lit cut's width, then the levels and the reaches four to a vector, the colors and each sheet's shadows a
  // vector a sheet.
  let scene = null;
  const fieldBlock = new ArrayBuffer(160);
  const FU = new Float32Array(fieldBlock);
  const FN = new Int32Array(fieldBlock, 12, 1);
  const shadeBlock = new ArrayBuffer(1760);
  const SU = new Float32Array(shadeBlock);
  const SN = new Int32Array(shadeBlock, 12, 1);
  const at = new Float32Array(MAX_BUMPS * BUMP + 6);
  const bump = new Float32Array(MAX_BUMPS * BUMP);
  const rest = new Float32Array(6);
  const layout = (w, h) => {
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
    scene = papercutScene(ANGLE, SHAPE, w, h);
    const size = fieldSize(scene);
    field?.destroy();
    field = gpu.createTexture({
      size: [size.w, size.h],
      format: "rgba32uint",
      usage: GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT | GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING
    });
    FU.set([scene.width, scene.height, scene.D]);
    FN[0] = scene.bumps.length;
    FU.set([scene.rx, scene.ry], 4);
    FU.set([scene.wa, scene.wf, scene.wa2, scene.wf2], 8);
    const u = sceneUniforms(scene);
    SU.set([scene.width, scene.height, scene.D]);
    SN[0] = scene.n;
    SU.set(u.misc, 6);
    SU.set(u.level, 8);
    SU.set(u.reach, 32);
    for (let k = 0; k < MAX_SHEETS; k++) {
      SU.set(u.face.subarray(3 * k, 3 * k + 3), 56 + 4 * k);
      SU.set(u.wall.subarray(3 * k, 3 * k + 3), 152 + 4 * k);
      SU.set(u.shadow.subarray(3 * k, 3 * k + 3), 248 + 4 * k);
    }
    SU.set(u.sheet, 344);
    groups = {
      field: gpu.createBindGroup({
        layout: pField.getBindGroupLayout(0),
        entries: [{ binding: 0, resource: { buffer: fieldBuffer } }]
      }),
      shade: gpu.createBindGroup({
        layout: pShade.getBindGroupLayout(0),
        entries: [
          { binding: 0, resource: { buffer: shadeBuffer } },
          { binding: 1, resource: field.createView() }
        ]
      })
    };
  };

  const pass = (encoder, view, p, bindings) => {
    const at = encoder.beginRenderPass({
      colorAttachments: [{ view, loadOp: "clear", clearValue: [0, 0, 0, 1], storeOp: "store" }]
    });
    at.setPipeline(p);
    at.setBindGroup(0, bindings);
    at.draw(3);
    at.end();
  };
  // A frame at t seconds of the loop at speed 1, once the canvas has a size on this device: the field with the hills,
  // the waves and the light at t, then the sheets shaded from it on the canvas.
  const draw = t => {
    if (!groups) return;
    frameUniforms(scene, t, at, bump, rest);
    FU.set(rest.subarray(0, 4), 12);
    FU.set(bump, 16);
    SU.set(rest.subarray(4, 6), 4);
    gpu.queue.writeBuffer(fieldBuffer, 0, fieldBlock);
    gpu.queue.writeBuffer(shadeBuffer, 0, shadeBlock);
    const encoder = gpu.createCommandEncoder();
    pass(encoder, field.createView(), pField, groups.field);
    pass(encoder, context.getCurrentTexture().createView(), pShade, groups.shade);
    gpu.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
  };

  // The canvas's size in device pixels as the browser lays it out, up to a 4K screen's pixels, as the player sizes it.
  const PIXELS_MAX = 8300000;
  let pixels = null;
  let laidOut = false;
  const resize = () => {
    const dpr = devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const css = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!css.width || !css.height) return;
    const ew = Math.round(css.width * dpr);
    const eh = Math.round(css.height * dpr);
    const exact = pixels && Math.abs(pixels.w - ew) <= 2 && Math.abs(pixels.h - eh) <= 2;
    const w0 = exact ? pixels.w : ew;
    const h0 = exact ? pixels.h : eh;
    const fit = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(PIXELS_MAX / Math.max(1, w0 * h0)));
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w0 * fit));
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h0 * fit));
    layout(w, h);
    laidOut = true;
  };

  // The clock: seconds of the loop at speed 1, advanced by SPEED, so the motion eases in from rest over EASE seconds once
  // the first frame is drawn. A frame is drawn when the picture changed or one is due at FPS; a reader who asks for
  // less motion sees the first frame.
  const reduced = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  let lost = false;
  const playing = () => !document.hidden && !reduced.matches && !lost;
  let t = 0;
  let warm = 0;
  let last = performance.now();
  let lastDrawn = -1;
  let changed = true;
  let first = true;
  let raf = 0;
  let settle = 0;
  // A frame is due once each 1/FPS, a little early rather than a refresh late, counted from the last one's due time.
  let paced = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  const due = now => {
    if (!FPS) return true;
    const every = 1000 / FPS;
    if (now - paced < every - Math.min(4, every * 0.2)) return false;
    paced = now - paced > 2 * every ? now : paced + every;
    return true;
  };
  const tick = now => {
    raf = 0;
    if (lost) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    if (!playing() || SPEED === 0) warm = 0;
    else if (laidOut && !first) {
      warm = Math.min(EASE, warm + dt);
      const e = EASE ? warm / EASE : 1;
      t += dt * SPEED * e * e * (3 - 2 * e);
    }
    if (laidOut) {
      const at = reduced.matches ? 0 : t;
      if (changed || (at !== lastDrawn && due(now))) {
        draw(at);
        lastDrawn = at;
        changed = false;
        first = false;
      }
    }
    if (playing() && SPEED > 0) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  const wake = () => {
    last = performance.now();
    if (!raf && !lost) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  // The first size comes before the first paint; a later one settles a moment before the drawing is laid out again.
  const sizes = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    const box = entries[entries.length - 1]?.devicePixelContentBoxSize?.[0];
    pixels = box ? { w: box.inlineSize, h: box.blockSize } : null;
    clearTimeout(settle);
    settle = setTimeout(
      () => {
        resize();
        changed = true;
        wake();
      },
      laidOut ? 150 : 0
    );
  });
  try {
    sizes.observe(canvas, { box: "device-pixel-content-box" });
  } catch {
    sizes.observe(canvas);
  }
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (!document.hidden) wake();
  });
  reduced.addEventListener("change", () => {
    changed = true;
    wake();
  });
  // A GPU lost draws nothing, and the loop stops until a new drawing is made on the one found again, which is laid out
  // and drawn at once, the clock going on from where it was.
  const lose = () => {
    lost = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
  };
  const found = () => {
    lost = false;
    laidOut = false;
    resize();
    changed = true;
    wake();
  };
  // A device lost draws nothing: the page asks for another, three times at most, makes everything the GPU held again
  // on it and goes on, or says so.
  let again = 0;
  const watch = one =>
    one.lost.then(async () => {
      lose();
      const next = ++again <= 3 ? await request() : null;
      if (!next) {
        document.body.textContent = "This page lost its GPU device, and the browser gave it no other.";
        return;
      }
      gpu = next;
      make();
      watch(next);
      found();
    });
  watch(gpu);

  // the lit cut's width, then the levels and the reaches four to a vector, the colors and each sheet's shadows a
  // vector a sheet.
  let scene = null;
  const fieldBlock = new ArrayBuffer(160);
  const FU = new Float32Array(fieldBlock);
  const FN = new Int32Array(fieldBlock, 12, 1);
  const shadeBlock = new ArrayBuffer(1760);
  const SU = new Float32Array(shadeBlock);
  const SN = new Int32Array(shadeBlock, 12, 1);
  const at = new Float32Array(MAX_BUMPS * BUMP + 6);
  const bump = new Float32Array(MAX_BUMPS * BUMP);
  const rest = new Float32Array(6);
  const layout = (w, h) => {
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
    scene = papercutScene(ANGLE, SHAPE, w, h);
    const size = fieldSize(scene);
    field?.destroy();
    field = gpu.createTexture({
      size: [size.w, size.h],
      format: "rgba32uint",
      usage: GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT | GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING
    });
    FU.set([scene.width, scene.height, scene.D]);
    FN[0] = scene.bumps.length;
    FU.set([scene.rx, scene.ry], 4);
    FU.set([scene.wa, scene.wf, scene.wa2, scene.wf2], 8);
    const u = sceneUniforms(scene);
    SU.set([scene.width, scene.height, scene.D]);
    SN[0] = scene.n;
    SU.set(u.misc, 6);
    SU.set(u.level, 8);
    SU.set(u.reach, 32);
    for (let k = 0; k < MAX_SHEETS; k++) {
      SU.set(u.face.subarray(3 * k, 3 * k + 3), 56 + 4 * k);
      SU.set(u.wall.subarray(3 * k, 3 * k + 3), 152 + 4 * k);
      SU.set(u.shadow.subarray(3 * k, 3 * k + 3), 248 + 4 * k);
    }
    SU.set(u.sheet, 344);
    groups = {
      field: gpu.createBindGroup({
        layout: pField.getBindGroupLayout(0),
        entries: [{ binding: 0, resource: { buffer: fieldBuffer } }]
      }),
      shade: gpu.createBindGroup({
        layout: pShade.getBindGroupLayout(0),
        entries: [
          { binding: 0, resource: { buffer: shadeBuffer } },
          { binding: 1, resource: field.createView() }
        ]
      })
    };
  };

  const pass = (encoder, view, p, bindings) => {
    const at = encoder.beginRenderPass({
      colorAttachments: [{ view, loadOp: "clear", clearValue: [0, 0, 0, 1], storeOp: "store" }]
    });
    at.setPipeline(p);
    at.setBindGroup(0, bindings);
    at.draw(3);
    at.end();
  };
  // A frame at t seconds of the loop at speed 1, once the canvas has a size on this device: the field with the hills,
  // the waves and the light at t, then the sheets shaded from it on the canvas.
  const draw = t => {
    if (!groups) return;
    frameUniforms(scene, t, at, bump, rest);
    FU.set(rest.subarray(0, 4), 12);
    FU.set(bump, 16);
    SU.set(rest.subarray(4, 6), 4);
    gpu.queue.writeBuffer(fieldBuffer, 0, fieldBlock);
    gpu.queue.writeBuffer(shadeBuffer, 0, shadeBlock);
    const encoder = gpu.createCommandEncoder();
    pass(encoder, field.createView(), pField, groups.field);
    pass(encoder, context.getCurrentTexture().createView(), pShade, groups.shade);
    gpu.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
  };

  // The canvas's size in device pixels as the browser lays it out, up to a 4K screen's pixels, as the player sizes it.
  const PIXELS_MAX = 8300000;
  let pixels = null;
  let laidOut = false;
  const resize = () => {
    const dpr = devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const css = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!css.width || !css.height) return;
    const ew = Math.round(css.width * dpr);
    const eh = Math.round(css.height * dpr);
    const exact = pixels && Math.abs(pixels.w - ew) <= 2 && Math.abs(pixels.h - eh) <= 2;
    const w0 = exact ? pixels.w : ew;
    const h0 = exact ? pixels.h : eh;
    const fit = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(PIXELS_MAX / Math.max(1, w0 * h0)));
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w0 * fit));
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h0 * fit));
    layout(w, h);
    laidOut = true;
  };

  // The clock: seconds of the loop at speed 1, advanced by SPEED, so the motion eases in from rest over EASE seconds once
  // the first frame is drawn. A frame is drawn when the picture changed or one is due at FPS; a reader who asks for
  // less motion sees the first frame.
  const reduced = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  let lost = false;
  const playing = () => !document.hidden && !reduced.matches && !lost;
  let t = 0;
  let warm = 0;
  let last = performance.now();
  let lastDrawn = -1;
  let changed = true;
  let first = true;
  let raf = 0;
  let settle = 0;
  // A frame is due once each 1/FPS, a little early rather than a refresh late, counted from the last one's due time.
  let paced = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  const due = now => {
    if (!FPS) return true;
    const every = 1000 / FPS;
    if (now - paced < every - Math.min(4, every * 0.2)) return false;
    paced = now - paced > 2 * every ? now : paced + every;
    return true;
  };
  const tick = now => {
    raf = 0;
    if (lost) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    if (!playing() || SPEED === 0) warm = 0;
    else if (laidOut && !first) {
      warm = Math.min(EASE, warm + dt);
      const e = EASE ? warm / EASE : 1;
      t += dt * SPEED * e * e * (3 - 2 * e);
    }
    if (laidOut) {
      const at = reduced.matches ? 0 : t;
      if (changed || (at !== lastDrawn && due(now))) {
        draw(at);
        lastDrawn = at;
        changed = false;
        first = false;
      }
    }
    if (playing() && SPEED > 0) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  const wake = () => {
    last = performance.now();
    if (!raf && !lost) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  // The first size comes before the first paint; a later one settles a moment before the drawing is laid out again.
  const sizes = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    const box = entries[entries.length - 1]?.devicePixelContentBoxSize?.[0];
    pixels = box ? { w: box.inlineSize, h: box.blockSize } : null;
    clearTimeout(settle);
    settle = setTimeout(
      () => {
        resize();
        changed = true;
        wake();
      },
      laidOut ? 150 : 0
    );
  });
  try {
    sizes.observe(canvas, { box: "device-pixel-content-box" });
  } catch {
    sizes.observe(canvas);
  }
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (!document.hidden) wake();
  });
  reduced.addEventListener("change", () => {
    changed = true;
    wake();
  });
  // A GPU lost draws nothing, and the loop stops until a new drawing is made on the one found again, which is laid out
  // and drawn at once, the clock going on from where it was.
  const lose = () => {
    lost = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
  };
  const found = () => {
    lost = false;
    laidOut = false;
    resize();
    changed = true;
    wake();
  };
  // A device lost draws nothing: the page asks for another, three times at most, makes everything the GPU held again
  // on it and goes on, or says so.
  let again = 0;
  const watch = one =>
    one.lost.then(async () => {
      lose();
      const next = ++again <= 3 ? await request() : null;
      if (!next) {
        document.body.textContent = "This page lost its GPU device, and the browser gave it no other.";
        return;
      }
      gpu = next;
      make();
      watch(next);
      found();
    });
  watch(gpu);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
